findings.title: Trailing malformed page discards prior pages in _fetch_changed_files_rest
findings.body: The try/except json.JSONDecodeError in tools/pr_steward/collector.py::_fetch_changed_files_rest wraps the entire page-accumulation loop, so a malformed trailing page discards previously-accumulated pages and returns ([], [error]). This is fail-closed (HARVEST_INCOMPLETE), not a security bypass. Accepted as-is; no trust-boundary impact.

findings.title: _changed_files() lacks isinstance(item, dict) guard
findings.body: tools/pr_steward/classifier.py::_changed_files() does not guard isinstance(item, dict) before calling .get(). Pre-existing condition from before this PR; the REST normalizer upstream already validates dict-type entries before they reach this function. No regression introduced by this fix.

fixes_applied: Classify tools/pr_steward/** and .github/actions/** as security-sensitive (trust-root self-protection) in security_release_gate.py.
Require reviewer authorAssociation in {OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR} in addition to roster membership in security_release_approval.py.

Fix bidirectional bot-login normalization bug (found by independent Claude security-engineer audit): a roster entry stored as 'foo[bot]' can no longer match an unrelated bare login 'foo' — only the candidate login is normalized, never the roster.

Migrate canonical changed-file source from `gh pr view --json files` to paginated REST pulls/{n}/files, and classify pre-rename paths alongside destination paths (closes a rename-out-of-protected-path bypass found by independent Grok CLI audit at head 7b7690fe8c25fc154fd1816d115098904262ac65).
remaining_risks: None beyond the two INFO findings above — all claimed fixes verified end-to-end against the exact audited head; pagination behavior and multi-hop-rename collapse confirmed empirically.
